description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository for performing database operations related to UserEntity objects, including a custom finder method based on identificationNumber.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for UserEntity entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom lookup method.

methods.name: findByIdentificationNumber
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the UserEntity with the specified identification number, if exists.
